claims.text: Chinchilla finds prior large models undertrained and prescribes roughly equal scaling of model size and training tokens (~20 tokens/param), shifting the efficiency question toward data allocation.
The result underwrites the Special's training-token-reduction thread (dedup, DoReMi) and the Qwen/DeepSeek scaling-law refits.
claims.context: Editorial linkage; refit claims belong to D008/D124.

limitations.text: Full-body isoFLOP curves and ablation tables not consumed; ratio quoted as the paper's headline prescription, not a universal constant.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.
